title: IN YOUR STORE
description: At left a 56px sentence says Gentrit Rashiti builds the phone and web apps that shoppers, readers and care teams use, above a list of four store apps with a colour band on Read to Feed; in the middle are two public store frames of that app and at right a fact line and two working codes with the exact URLs under them. Move the band by click, drag or arrow keys, or drag the frames sideways, and the frames slide, the facts change and the codes rewrite only the squares that differ; on a phone the codes become store buttons and one frame sits under the list.
signature: Big Shoulders Display 800 for the claim (56px), the wheel (40px), the hook line and headings, Public Sans text at 17px, JetBrains Mono 14px for years and URLs; paper and ink tinted toward red, with the colour of the selected app (Read to Feed blue, Bayyinah maroon, Viva Fresh red set 8 percent darker for 4.5:1 white text, Dukagjini red; all sampled from the app's own store frame) marking only the selected band and the focus ring; one story moment: the codes write themselves from the centre outwards in 700 ms (expo-out), then spring.snap (600/40) on the band and a 320 ms rewrite of the squares that differ; the first paint is held up to 700 ms for the faces so the claim never reflows.
rule: The page is a launcher that turns each shipped app into a code your phone can scan.
designRead: Reading this as: a frontend and mobile developer for hiring managers and founders who want shipped phone apps, leading with Read to Feed (about 14 releases in four years), in the rule of a launcher: every public app on the page is a working code that opens it in the visitor's own store, or its archived page.
hook: The one where you pick one of the four store apps, the page turns that app's colour, and a code appears that opens it on your phone.
lead: Read to Feed: by CONTENT.md the longest checkable record (about 14 releases to both stores in 2022 to 2025, three major upgrades; the owner's case title is 'four years of releases'). Bayyinah TV is stronger as a live product but p12-crafted leads with it. Viva Fresh, the first lead, has no number. Weakness shown, not hidden: the store pages are removed, so the heading states the record and the archive is the small label under each code.
composition: first-screen.md #6, one mechanism the visitor operates: claim and list at left, two real store frames in the middle, a fact line and two codes at right; the four answers are text and need no input. On a phone the codes are replaced by store buttons and one frame sits under the list.

fourAnswers.desktop: Who: Gentrit Rashiti. What: builds phone and web apps (frontend and mobile developer, full stack since 2026). For whom: shoppers, readers and care teams. Proof: Read to Feed, about 14 releases in four years, two codes with archived store URLs, two real store frames, four named apps with years 2021 to 2026.
fourAnswers.phone: Same sentence in three lines; proof is the four named apps with years, the App Store and Google Play buttons (marked archived for the lead) and one real store frame from y=478.

holdback: Original and hook, 7 each by my own score (the reviewer gave 8 and 8). A list that drives a stage is a known pattern; the new part is its output, working codes, and the memory sentence is a practical fact, not a moment. The write-on plays once at load and phones have no codes. Care-platform proof sits below the first screen because the lead is a mobile app.
skillNotes: HELPED. directions.md: the mechanism table with delete tests, the costume list and the 'the page is a ___ that ___' sentence made me write the rule before any layout, and EXISTING.md showed which control patterns were taken (sun, seam, quality menu, scan to basket) so I looked for a new output instead. motion.md: the build order (end state, cause, token, interruptible, keyboard, reduced) and the tokens worked verbatim: spring.snap 600/40 with velocity hand-off, expo-out for the write-on, 150 ms underline, 'keyboard never animates' became a key-versus-pointer branch, 'multiply by dt' became performance.now. first-screen.md: the four answers and the phone rules ('work above 500px', 'design it, do not shrink it') forced a separate phone layout (wheel above the frame, codes replaced by store buttons). writing.md's translation table (component to building block, query to database request) fixed copy fast. The checker found real defects: C05 hard-failed on 'CV' (a 17px-wide link) and CLS 0.098 on the phone came only from the font swap; T10b caught 'Built with React Native' and T45 caught '21,000' versus '21k' in CONTENT.md. The mid-round checker upgrade fixed my first complaint (canvas counted as work; now only inside data-work, and 'Work counted' lines show what was counted). UNCLEAR OR WRONG. (1) press-and-hover.css puts the grow-in underline at background-position 0 100% and only inside (hover: hover): on a 44px-tall inline-flex link (the target rule) the line sits 15px below the text, and on touch in-text links have no underline at all. I used calc(50% + 0.72em) with background-origin content-box and an underline at rest for links in text, grow-in only for the masthead; the snippet should say so. (2) visual.md says 'metric-matched fallback' but gives no recipe: I measured the width ratio of the real face over Arial with canvas.measureText and set size-adjust, ascent-override, descent-override; measuring mixed text gave 74% and flipped the claim from 5 lines to 4 (CLS 0.009), measuring the claim string alone (77.5%) gave CLS 0. A snippet and the 'measure the claim itself' warning would save an hour. (3) Short link words ('CV', 'Work') need padding to be 44px wide; the skill states height only. (4) --frames counts from navigation start: on an SPA with a lazy route the 150 and 400 ms frames are the host app's loader, and a moment that starts after fonts.ready lands in the 900 ms frame only; a --frames-after <selector> option (or a window.__storyStart marker) would make mid-frames useful. I captured my own series with Playwright. (5) Budget must be checked on a production build: the dev server gave LCP 1.5 to 1.8 s at 4x throttle (C17 warning, jsxDEV alone 70 ms of scripting) while a vite build served from a temp outDir gave 0.64 to 0.76 s with no findings; say so in motion.md step 6 and give the command. (6) 'If original or hook is 7 or less go back to direct' cannot be tested before building, and builders over-score; I scored 7/7 honestly and stayed, which the skill reads as 'park it'. A pre-build test (write the memory sentence, then ask which EXISTING line it could also describe) would be more useful. Also unclear when a control pattern (a list that drives a stage, like hybrid) counts as a different draft from the existing one; the divergence rules talk about skeletons and rules, not controls. (7) M06 (wheel moved the page 1520 of 4394 px) fired once on a phone run and never again, and I could not reproduce it by hand; flaky. (8) T07 flagged a footer link because a grid stretched the underline-gradient link past 60,000 px2; the fix is justify-self: start, but the skill's own underline recipe uses the same gradient. MISSING. An accessible pattern for visitor-driven selectors (radio group with visually hidden inputs, pointer capture only after 5 px so clicks still work, click suppression after a drag, rubber band at the ends, touch-action) and a one-page 'mechanism spec' (pointer, touch, keyboard, interrupt, reduced motion, delete test) would shorten Bold builds a lot. For M3 ('the technique is real') add: prove it with an independent tool; I compared my QR matrices with the qrcode library (56 of 56 identical) and decoded screenshots of the live page with ZXing at 1x and 2x. No guidance on what counts as 'work' when the hook is a generated artefact (a code): I kept it out of the work share and let the real store frames carry 30 percent. POLISH PASS, new snippets. mechanism.md and press-and-hover.css helped: the spec table made me add pan-y, 5 px capture, click suppression and a horizontal swipe on the output; the text-decoration underline and the span-underline masthead removed my detached-underline bug. Problems: (1) mechanism.md says 'touch-action: pan-y on horizontal controls'; my control is a vertical list, where the right answer was pan-y plus tap-only on touch and a horizontal swipe on the output, so the page can scroll under a vertical control; say so. (2) font-loading.md pattern 1 gives ascent-override 92% and descent-override 24%; the overrides are relative to the size-adjusted size, so for Big Shoulders at 77.5% they came out 127% and 27.5% (face ascent 0.984 and descent 0.213 divided by the size-adjust). More important: one size-adjust cannot keep a multi-line claim's line breaks at every width (390 needed 76 percent or less, 1440 needed 76.9 percent or more); pattern 2 (hold the first paint up to 700 ms) gave CLS 0 at six widths. Recommend pattern 2 first for a multi-line claim. (3) Review found a bug the checker could not: a CSS reset written as '.root p {margin:0}' beats every class margin in the draft (heading and line touched, spacing under MORE); anti-slop.md or visual.md should say 'write resets with :where()'. (4) The checker's contrast sample skips a solid coloured band, which is how 4.37:1 shipped; I measured it with a script on all four band colours; the checker could sample text on any solid background that is not the page ground. (5) The checker's new --frames-after and --interact are what I needed earlier: the click frames at 60, 150, 300 ms showed the band mid-slide and the codes rewriting. (6) The skill's own writing.md example ('Care teams keep using the app while each screen moves over') made it into this draft verbatim and was wrong for the facts; the owner decision (no React screen is live) shows that a work-in-progress line must say what is not live, as the review noted.

facts: Care row heading is the owner's H1, 'Rebuilding a live care platform, one tested screen at a time.', and the text says 'No React screen is live yet.' (the line 'Care teams keep using the app while each screen moves over' is gone).
Design System v2 keeps the owner's wording ('A team effort', no individual credit).
Hero line adds 'full stack since 2026' (CONTENT.md role line); words cut elsewhere so the first screen is 88 words.
gate: Contrast: the year and name on the selected band now pass 4.5:1 on all four apps (5.3, 10.4, 5.1, 5.1 measured; Viva Fresh band is the store red 8 percent darker, 217,24,31, because 237,29,38 gave 4.37:1).
Focus: the focused row shows a double ring on the band (3px ink outside, 2px white inside); the old box around the whole list is gone.
clarity: Lead changed from Viva Fresh to Read to Feed and the list is ordered by strength (Read to Feed, Bayyinah TV, Viva Fresh, Dukagjini). Why: the longest checkable record in CONTENT.md; Bayyinah TV is p12-crafted's lead.
Read to Feed heading is 'About 14 releases in four years'; 'archived' is the small label under each code and in the buttons, with the archive month ('Nov 2025').

Codes: the caps kicker is now a fact line, the extra caption is gone, no screen shows both buttons and codes (buttons below 1200px, codes from 1200px); the code stays because it is the rule and the hook.

The wheel is now driven: mouse drag on the list with the snap spring and velocity hand-off, sideways drag on the store frames, horizontal trackpad swipe over the frames, click, arrow keys (instant). Touch swipe on the frames changes the app.
Table of the four apps gets a Result column (a checkable result per app) and drops 'Where'.
phone: The list no longer blocks scrolling: touch-action is pan-y and touch pointers are left to the page; tapping a row still picks it (tested: swipe up over the list scrolls, scrollY moved).
The store frame starts at y=478 (was 520+): claim is 3 lines at 32px, one-line years and place.
Care screen on a phone is a readable crop (first card, month, program tabs) at 94 percent of its size, not the whole screen at 30 percent.
craft: Heading and line no longer touch: the reset '.pb-root p {margin:0}' outranked every class margin; it is now written with :where(). 10px on phone, 20px on desktop. This also fixed the spacing under 'MORE' and in the facts block.
Document background and theme-color are set to the page paper while the draft is open and restored on leaving, so iOS overscroll and the browser bar are not black.
Links in text are underlined with text-decoration (under the words, not under the 44px padding); the masthead uses the span underline from press-and-hover.css.

First paint is held up to 700 ms for the display and text faces (font-loading.md pattern 2); CLS is 0 at 390, 412, 768, 1280, 1440 and 1920 (a single size-adjust could not hold the claim's line breaks at both 390 and 1440).
Store frames show their own ground colour while they load.
notDone: Cropping the stage to the screen inside the device: the Bayyinah frames are tilted renders with no flat screen to crop, so a crop would give the stage two kinds of picture.
The '2 database requests, not 16' line stays in the care row, not on the first screen: the owner rule makes it a proof line and the first screen is at the 90-word budget.
polish.check: 0 hard fails, 0 warnings at 1440 and 390 on the dev server and on a production build served at 4x CPU throttle (LCP 952 ms and 896 ms); tsc passes.
